en-US.longDescription: Most IP cameras do not support direct image upload. With the Skyvex Webcam Uploader you can connect any IP camera that provides a snapshot via HTTP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50/snap.jpg). The program fetches an image from your camera at regular intervals and uploads it to your Skyvex account automatically.
en-US.name: Skyvex Webcam Uploader
